evidence.source: 《字源》, 李學勤主編, 2012, 天津古籍出版社 / 遼寧人民出版社, ISBN 9787552800692; attached source scan directly inspected
evidence.field: 好 headword; formation and meaning discussion; printed p. 1094 / PDF p. 1109; exact bronze quotation occurrence
evidence.text: The scan confirms the 好 headword and printed page 1094 (PDF page 1109). The author analyzes early forms as 女 plus 子 and proposes ‘woman’ as the original meaning, then discusses extensions to beauty/goodness and ‘like/love’; these are the author’s historical interpretations, not direct attestation of the proposed original meaning. At the cited bronze example, the scan reads exactly “虘钟：‘用乐好宾。’” The producer correction is verified as raw OCR span [1438,1439), 虐→虘; the following character remains printed simplified 钟. The effective OCR therefore has the exact passage literal 虘钟. The earlier evidence assertion “虘鐘” is incorrect in its second character. This page-specific record reflects the correction already applied by the producer; no further corpus edit was made.
